title: Evolutionary design produced high-motion volumetric bioactuators
summary: A simulation-guided evolutionary search selected muscle and scaffold geometries fabricated as volumetric bilayer bioactuators. Prototypes achieved up to 11-fold greater range of motion than prior designs with comparable muscle volume and demonstrated jumping, swimming, walking and gripping. The paper notes tissue-maturation and scale-up limits; demonstrations do not establish long-term operation or practical deployment.
